text: User decisions 2026-10-18: (1) widen spatial4s FrameId grammar to admit percent-escapes so persisted scalafim-world ids (native/tkras contain %007C etc.) stay byte-identical; (2) XformCode/SpaceEvidence/SpaceResolver go into neuroim4s-spaces; (3) WorldLink becomes a small dimension-generic DirectionalLink in reframe4s-core (ScalaFIM WorldLink deleted, missing-inverse suite ported); (4) create public canardlapin/neuroim4s once spaces passes JVM+JS. Keep the scalafim-world: prefix byte-identical (rename would be a separate schema migration). DeclaredToken's fresh-id mint is not a registry.
